defect_observations.observation: The tower theorem asserts that nesting is essential and that arbitrary conditioning sigma-algebras need not commute. Its declared proof item (annex 279-297) does not address this sentence, and neither the body nor the annex cross-references the witness in thm:p15-conditional-examples item 1 (body 355-361, annex 701-720). The content is present in the chapter; only the link is missing. This does not change the verdict.

C007 annex is compressed in three places. (a) The finite-p and L^inf norm axioms are each stated to follow from integral or pointwise laws in one sentence (231-233, 260-262). (b) Convexity of |t|^p is reduced to "integrating that monotonicity gives the secant inequalities" (235-239). (c) For p=inf, the integrability of X that is needed before conditioning is not stated (271-273); only finite p gets the Holder-against-one step (264-265). These are terse but present; not verdict-changing.

The C004 DCT limsup half is given as "Applying Fatou to Y-X_n likewise gives limsup C_G X_n <= C_G X". The operation and the conclusion are named, but the mirrored display is not written. C019 annex 679-680 treats A_- the same way ("The corresponding calculation"). Not verdict-changing.
C003 locality: "Their integral identity gives P(A_n)=0" leaves the lower bound integral >= P(A_n)/n implicit. That bound is displayed for order at 56-58.

C010: the recovery of def:p15-finite-conditional-expectation (parts/p15/finite-probability.tex 401-421) is asserted in one clause. The cell averages and the zero-on-null-fibre convention do match the earlier definition.

The queue record for ED26-P15-CH-conditional-expectation is stale. Its body_lines (C005 onward) and declared_proof_destinations (from conditional-jensen onward) predate the inserted paragraph (body 111-120, +11 lines) and annex 168-172 (+5 lines). C020 text also gained the clause at body 366-368. Current line numbers are cited. All other entry texts are identical to exact_current_text.

Lookup is not an owed component of section 159.5 and was not assessed. Only def:p15-general-conditional-expectation carries index entries; the other 20 maintained entries have none. The queue destination records final_subject_task_cases_pending=true.

C018 wording: "the explicitly allowed zero-count extension" names no authority. The held source (printed p.216, Ex. 4.1.8) states only positive-integer N. The extension is the handbook's own and is proved (annex 627, 656). The sentence does not attribute it to the source.
